title: Siege of Diriyah
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Diriyah", at revision 1382386176, opens: "The siege of Diriyah was a successful Ottoman siege that took place in late 1818 at the end of the Wahhabi War of 1811–1818 during the Nejd Expedition." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3656346, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "military conflict of 1818". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
